visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with a high ponytail, wearing a white T-shirt with the text 'CHERIE' and a blue-and-green plaid skirt, points her finger excitedly towards a distant fountain. She has a wide, joyful smile and squinted eyes. Behind her is an ornate green bronze fountain in a park-like setting under a bright, clear blue sky with white clouds. (2) The scene shifts to a wide establishing shot of the Jourdeness Castle, a grand white neoclassical building with impressive columns, arches, and a central domed roof. A large, tiered fountain sits in a circular turquoise pool in front, surrounded by manicured green hedges and red flowers. A woman in a white oversized T-shirt later poses beside a life-sized wax figure of a British royal guard in a red coat and tall bearskin hat. (3) A fast-paced montage displays various outdoor spots: two classic red London telephone booths, colorful mailboxes, and a white stone pavilion with a black dome. The woman and child are seen walking, running, and posing in these garden spaces. The lighting is bright, direct natural daylight throughout. (4) The camera moves indoors to show a high, white circular dome ceiling with intricate geometric patterns. A vintage black-and-silver Rolls-Royce car is parked on a red carpet. The woman and child participate in a DIY craft, pouring blue liquid into a bear-shaped mold. They are also seen in a room filled with mirrors, creating multiple reflections. The girl briefly wears a light blue lab coat in front of an educational graphic. A giant inflatable white cat mascot with a red bow is also shown. (5) Close-up shots of gourmet food are presented on white plates: two golden-brown fried fish fillets with broccoli and pumpkin, and a grilled chicken thigh with mushrooms and a lemon wedge. The video concludes with the girl sitting on a red velvet throne wearing a crown, followed by a final scene where the woman and girl wave and smile at the camera in the garden.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional travel vlog for the Jourdeness Castle in Chiayi, Taiwan. By showcasing diverse attractions including European architecture, family-friendly activities like DIY workshops, and high-quality dining, the video aims to attract tourists and families. The recurring mention of the 'Chiayi Fun Card' suggests the primary goal is to encourage viewers to purchase this pass for their local travel experiences.
